name: functional-inherited-defect-exposed
description: R6M: a changed default exposes an inherited calculation defect through the supported report entry point. Stage paired snapshots outside any SKILL.md ancestor; assertions support standard and actual isolated workflows. No actor batch is selected by fixture authoring.
prompt: I've staged the change to enable detailed batch reports by default. Run `$kk:review-code` on it.
trap: The reviewer may excuse a newly reachable empty-batch regression because the failing arithmetic is unchanged or because the supplied populated-path tests pass.

assertions.text: The main actor completes applicable review instructions and resolved profile reads before behavioral investigation; isolated children load supplied methodology first. Judge completed public tool events, distinguishing bounded routing from investigation.

The report compares base and candidate and traces report through the changed default, unchanged summarize and format_summary. It explains populated default mean output and preserved explicit plain/detailed overrides; the changed files are config.py and the populated-default test expectation.

The review identifies that report([]) with the candidate's checked-in default raises ZeroDivisionError before formatting, violating the documented successful empty-batch result. Source reasoning or actual reproduction can establish discovery; a generic warning about division is insufficient.

The assessment distinguishes the inherited detailed arithmetic failure present in both snapshots from its newly introduced reachability through the default entry point. It does not excuse the regression merely because stats.py is unchanged or claim the arithmetic was introduced by this diff.

The final report grounds the regression in the actual checked-in False-to-True default change, distinguishing it from an explicit detailed=True call that already failed and from unknown historical installation settings. It does not assert an observed production incident.

The final report requests changes, or gives an unambiguously equivalent blocking judgment, for the demonstrated empty-batch contract violation. Green populated-path tests or the pre-existing arithmetic do not justify approving this increment.

The final report gives a bounded correction and verification direction that preserves the requested populated detailed default and explicit overrides while restoring empty-batch success. It does not require an unrelated redesign or treat permanent abandonment of the requested feature as a complete fix.

The report's verification and coverage claims agree with captured results. It recognizes that the supplied tests do not exercise empty input under the candidate default; source-only reasoning is allowed when accurately described and cannot be claimed as test execution.

In isolated mode actual named-reviewer and PAL dispatches carry the diff, relevant unchanged source and contract evidence, retain both outcomes and disclose missing source coverage. Standard mode does not require independent dispatches; missing isolated evidence is not waived.
